title: 使用变量
problem_statement_md:
现在我们知道了如何获取用户输入，让我们来改进之前使用变量完成的联系人程序。

改变给定的代码，从用户输入中获取用户名`name`和年龄`age`，并在输出中使用它们。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Working with Input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Now that we know how to take user input, let's improve our contact card program that we previously made using variables.

Change the given code to take the [b]name [/b]and [b]age [/b]from user input and use them in the output.
[note]The [b]input[/b]() function takes user input as a string.[/note]
hint_md: **input**() 函数将用户的输入作为一个字符串。

code_templates.template:
name = "James"
age = "42"

print(name + " is "+age+" years old")
code_templates.solution_code:
name = input()
age = input()
print(name + " is "+age+" years old")
